changes_made.explanation: Removed RoleRM (fine-tuned model) as it's not an LLM-as-judge but a specialized evaluation model. Kept general LLMs used for evaluation. Normalized model names and simplified methods to 'prompt-based scoring' as the main approach.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on role-playing dialogue generation and evaluation. It introduces Crab framework with configurable RP-LLMs and RoleRM evaluation model. Human evaluation used 4-point scale for six fine-grained criteria. LLM-as-judge comparisons include ChatGPT and other LLM-based evaluators.
